descriptionSet.display: The main gate (Bāb or Sabah al Maqabarah) into the small settlement of Misfāt al ‘Abrīyin, was originally a rear gateway leading to the cemetery (maqabarah). Like most other settlement entrances in Oman, until about 1965, this exposed gateway was closed with heavy wooden gates around 8.00 pm every evening to safeguard the village from any assaults. The upper floor is actually accessed through the adjoining dwelling to its east; dwellings collectively form the outer edge of the settlement quarter. The gate leads on to the main passage of the settlement, Sikkat at-Tawī, which winds down through the quarter following the challenging topography.

description.source: Bandyopadhyay, Soumyen et al, Tourism Development Plan: Misfat al-Abriyin, Al-Hamra, Liverpool: University of Liverpool, 2015
